events.title: September Updates – A Few More Clowns
events.summary: Hi everyone, September is almost done! Here’s a look at what’s been worked on for Harlequinade~The first draft of Harlequinade is nearing completion, with Giles’ route on its epilogue section and Lynn’s route still in progress. I’ve been focusing on Giles’ route to get a feel for how long the game should be and how the routes should go, rather than jumping between both routes.
